openingMessage: Protect the group. Protect the work. Our jobs, our clients, and our reputation depend on it.
openingWhy: One pencil-whipped form on one location can put a whole client relationship in review. The operator doesn't just grade the hand that slipped — they grade Canon. Every crew in this Basin is either protected or exposed by what happens on your location today.
leadershipThought: Think before you speak. Think before you joke. Think before you act. Ask yourself: if this shows up in front of a client, my family, or leadership — does it represent me well? If the answer is no — don't do it.
